name: Pere (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pere: a blue and green shield with a patriarchal cross, a star and a crown, between ears of grain, above a scroll inscribed PERE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
